# Jacketee

> Jacketee is an online store for varsity, bomber, leather, puffer, and other jackets, with custom colors, patches, embroidery, and bulk order options.

## Website

- Homepage: https://jacketee.com/
- Shop: https://jacketee.com/shop
- Varsity jackets: https://jacketee.com/varsity-jackets
- Bulk orders: https://jacketee.com/bulk-orders
- Materials and colors: https://jacketee.com/materials-colors
- Patches and embroidery: https://jacketee.com/patches-embroidery
- Size guide: https://jacketee.com/size-guide
- Blog: https://jacketee.com/blog
- FAQ: https://jacketee.com/faq
- Shipping information: https://jacketee.com/shipping
- Returns and exchanges: https://jacketee.com/returns
- Contact: https://jacketee.com/contact
- Privacy policy: https://jacketee.com/privacy-policy
- Terms of service: https://jacketee.com/terms-of-service

## Guidance

Use public Jacketee pages as the source of truth for current product, policy, shipping, and support information. Do not expose private account, checkout, admin, order, or API data.
